"""
A = <T , P>
                    where 
                    T: ℝ ^ 3: a sequence
                    P: ℝ ^ 3: a sequence 
"""
import numpy as np
import scipy
import scipy.linalg
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.integrate import quad, solve_ivp
from scipy.optimize import minimize


class heartlib:
    def __init__(self, T, P):
        T = np.asarray(T, dtype=np.float64)
        P = np.asarray(P, dtype=np.float64)
        assert T.shape == (3,)
        assert P.shape == (3,)
        # A = <T , P>
        self.A = np.inner(T, P)
